messages:
tess-oncall: saw ~0.9% TLS handshakes failing on eu->na after the morning deploy. opening this thread for owners and timeline.

omar-net: checking LB egress now, I see clustered SYN retransmits and odd MSS values on SYN-ACKs from a subset of gateways between 09:05-09:18.

mira-sre: can you attach a quick log snippet or a pcap when ready?

omar-net: sample log in incident doc. capturing pcap and will upload to s3. plan to run a tcp replay in staging.

chris-platform: note the deploy enabled session stickiness; that might have concentrated traffic onto the affected gateway pool. we should have a deploy gate.

rita-pm: propose automatic rollback if handshake_fail_rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m during deploy. who owns that gate?

chris-platform: platform owns deploy gates. i'll add an alert + a rollback playbook hook, ETA 48h.

mira-sre: short-term owner: omar to validate pcap and test `sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1` in staging; due EOD Thu.

omar-net: ack. staging test plan: enable mtu_probing on one gateway, run synthetic load, compare handshake success and upload pcap to s3://redwood-logs/pcaps/1929991234-mtu.pcap

notify-bot: INC-6001 created: "egress MSS anomaly -> TLS handshake increase" assigned omar-net, mira-sre.

mira-sre: mid-term: add per-route (region_src->region_dst) handshake-failure metric to Console and a per-route alert. owner=mira-sre, PR by next Tue.

rita-pm: timeline check  if staging verifies tomorrow, can we target prod change Fri EOD?

chris-platform: if staging shows >99.9% success and alert/playbook wired, Fri EOD is feasible. i'll prioritize the gate work.

omaar-net: staging done, mtu_probing raised success from 99.2%->99.99% in synthetic. uploaded pcap and notes to the incident doc.

mira-sre: great. sam-oncall please confirm when you want this closed; recommend keep open 24h after prod stable.

tess-oncall: thanks all. keeping thread open; will add final closure note after 24h stable in prod.
